question: Which of the following legislations ought to allow senior Indian magistrates to preside over cases involving British subjects in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**llbert Bill, 1884.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **llbert Bill, 1884 **ought to allow senior Indian magistrates to preside over cases involving British subjects in India.
 
• The Ilbert Bill was introduced on 9 February 1883 during the Viceroyship of the Lord Ripon, which was drafted by Sir Courtenay Peregrine Ilbert, the legal member of the Council of the Governor-General of India.
 
• It was concerned about the jurisdiction of Magistrates or Sessions Judges to try charges against European British subjects if they were themselves not European.
 
• The bill led to intense opposition in Britain and from British settlers in India that ultimately played on racial tension before it was enacted in 1884 in a severely compromised state.
 
• After this controversial bill, the formation of the Indian National Congress took place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Age of Consent Act,1891__:

 
 
• It forbade the marriage of girls having aged less than 12 years.
 
• It was a reward for the efforts of Parsi reformer B.M.Malabari.
 
• He wrote in his notes that infant marriages and enforced widowhood were social evils that needed to be eliminated.
 
 
 
• **The Ingress into India Ordinance, 1914**, a law passed in British India in September 1914, at the outset of World War I, allowed the Government of India to screen, detain, and restrict the movement of people returning to India.
 
• **The Government of India Act 1919** was an Act of the Parliament of the United Kingdom.
 
 
• Government of India Act, 1919 also known as **Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms** came into force in 1921.
 
• It was instituted in the British Indian polity to introduce the Dyarchy.
